title: Linux server Ansible variables
description: The variables the Linux server playbooks read from an inventory. Variables not listed here are permitted. The x-canopy annotation tells Canopy how to hold a variable: secret (its value is a secret), scope (the scopes it may be set at: group, environment, machine; any where absent), applications (the application types it configures; any where absent), reserved (set by the inventory plugin, never stored), and spec (the requirement that defines it). The top-level x-canopy annotation lists the playbooks a run can start, each with its description, the intent it is run with, the run button it backs (preset), the application types it configures, and the tags it takes, and describes the tags that have a documented meaning.

tamanu-install.yml.description: Every arrangement a Tamanu server requires, including its database, services and proxy.

tamanu-upgrade.yml.description: The upgrade of the Tamanu version.

ansible_host.description: Address a run connects to, overriding the one Canopy holds for the machine.

ansible_port.description: SSH port a run connects to.

baseline_syslog_exclude_prefixes.description: Program tag prefixes whose messages are dropped from /var/log/syslog. They stay in the journal.

baseline_syslog_excludes.description: Programs whose messages are dropped from /var/log/syslog, matched exactly. They stay in the journal.

bestool_version.description: Version of bestool, read by the Raspberry Pi role only.

caddy_canopy_certificates.description: Whether sites name the certificate endpoint.

caddy_zerossl_api_key.description: A ZeroSSL API key that adds ZeroSSL as an issuer.

canopy_intent.description: The intent of the run, set by the inventory plugin.

dangerously_leave_ufw_alone.description: Whether an unmanaged host firewall is left as the server has it.

elastic_agent_enabled.description: Whether the endpoint security agent runs.

elastic_agent_enrollment_token.description: The enrolment token of the endpoint security agent.

elastic_agent_fleet_url.description: The URL of the Fleet that the endpoint security agent enrols in. Defaults to the production Fleet.

is_iti.description: Whether the host is a Tamanu Iti device.

managed_by_ansible.description: Whether runs configure this machine. Machines without it are left out of the inventory.

podman_network_subnets_v4.description: IPv4 subnets of the default Podman network, each with its gateway.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: The gateway address within the subnet.

podman_network_subnets_v6.description: IPv6 subnets of the default Podman network, each with its gateway.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: The gateway address within the subnet.

postgresql_upgrade_enabled.description: Whether major version upgrades are enabled.

postgresql_version.description: The major version of the cluster.

tailnet.description: The tailnet name used to form Tailscale hostnames.

tailscale_tags.description: Tags the server advertises, comma-separated. With tailscale_name, writes the ts-up helper.

tamanu_allow_downgrade.description: Permits a version lower than the deployed version.

tamanu_caddy_extra_hostnames.description: Additional hostnames that the proxy serves.

tamanu_caddy_tls.description: Whether the proxy serves HTTPS on the public hostname.

tamanu_caddy_tls_dns_iam.description: The Route 53 credentials of a server.

secret_access_key.title: Secret access key

tamanu_clone.description: Whether the deployment is a clone, set by the inventory plugin from the rank.

tamanu_country_alpha2.description: Central localisation: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

tamanu_country_alpha3.description: Central localisation: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

tamanu_extra_certs.description: Whether Tamanu containers trust the host certificate store.

tamanu_facility_id.description: The facility identifier of a facility server.

tamanu_frontend_version.description: The image tag of the frontend. Defaults to tamanu_version.

tamanu_tailscale_tls.description: Whether the proxy serves HTTPS on the Tailscale hostname.
